name: TOOLS-GITHUB-ACTIONS-MONITOR-WATCH
technologies: Read API v1 of GitHub Actions Monitor
build: Not built yet: there is no watch project. The repository checks run with python -I tools/ci_validate.py.
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: the planned minimal watch version of the Android app of GitHub Actions Monitor, which follows TOOLS-GITHUB-ACTIONS-MONITOR-ANDROID and would show a small part of what the monitor knows. It only reads from the monitor and writes nothing to GitHub. There is no code yet: this repository holds only its base (documents, manifest, licence and shared checks). Nothing has been built, tested or run on a watch; how the watch gets its data is not decided.
